correctness.rationale: For Q=[-1,1]^3 and Haar unit normal, direct cube-edge intersection independently matches the exact convolution area A(y,z)=4sqrt(1+y²+z²)(1-(y+z-1)_+²/(4yz)), with 4 vertices for y+z<1 and 6 for y+z>1. The maximizers (1,1,0)/sqrt2 are credited to Ball. The Haar chart has weight (6/pi)(1+y²+z²)^(-3/2); both corner neighborhoods contribute. In y=1-s,z=t, the quadrant linear deficit is 2sqrt2 s; in the hexagonal chamber it is sqrt2(t+s²/t), uniformly. Local comparability confines tail mass to O(delta) and dominated convergence gives scaled domain areas 1/16 and (2+pi)/32. The resulting joint coefficients 3sqrt2/(16pi) and 3sqrt2(2+pi)/(32pi), sum and conditional limits, are correct for absolute area deficit (not squared deficit). Independent check clipped 180 Haar/near-extreme directions and verified the limiting domain integrals. No finite test proves the limit.
